dispositions.rationale: Fresh TASK-0015 audit found no exact-pinned external equivalent for Foundation's governance-pressure and failure-assurance method. ECC agent-architecture-audit diagnoses agent-stack layers but does not own stale-state, retry, partial-effect, or governance-bypass pressure. Reliability owns production operability, not this governance-pressure boundary.

Mandatory Foundation organizational-role owner for repository binding, routing, planning authority, task creation, and final review judgment. External L2 architecture methodology cannot own or grant this L0 authority.

Google Cloud Run deployment, IAM, scaling, billing, and provider behavior are platform-specific HOW, not a Foundation-wide capability. Generic deployment patterns do not become Cloud Run authority; exact target-repository truth and current provider guidance own this HOW for each target.

Exact-pinned ECC agent-introspection-debugging is agent-run-specific and does not cover general software root-cause diagnosis. Superpowers systematic-debugging remains the admitted exact external owner for generic reproduce, trace, hypothesize, isolate, fix, and verify HOW; the former local delta duplicated Task Protocol, reliability, and role routing semantics.

Generic architecture/design review methodology is covered by exact-pinned ECC agent:architect. Foundation Architect and Task Protocol already own material-design authority, readiness, scope, and judgment, so a local design-review wrapper would only duplicate external HOW or existing L0 authority.

Mandatory Foundation organizational-role owner for exact task execution, mutation gates, divergence handling, evidence production, and Executor-local safety procedure. External L2 engineering methodology cannot own or grant this L0 authority.

Generic specification/acceptance completeness analysis is covered by exact-pinned ECC intent-driven-development, including scope, assumptions, missing decisions, observable criteria, and risk-relevant boundaries. Foundation Architect and Task Protocol retain material blocking-gap authority, so no local wrapper is needed.

Foundation-specific Git authority, canonical remote truth, publication, promotion lineage, topology, and release separation are already canonically owned by Task Protocol and role procedure. Generic Git/GitHub HOW routes through exact-pinned ECC git-workflow/github-ops under the TASK-0014 seam; keeping a wrapper would restate existing owners.

Exact-pinned ECC benchmark-optimization-loop fully owns generic measured baseline, bottleneck, bounded-variant, correctness-gate, and re-measure HOW. The former local delta only repeated Executor/verification execution-bundle safety and existing authority boundaries.

Fresh ECC audit found only narrower deployment and error-handling capabilities, not one exact owner for bounded operability across dependency failure, retries, backpressure, state recovery, rollout/rollback, incident response, and recovery exercises. Standards define required properties/evidence rather than this reusable operating method.

Exact-pinned ECC research-ops, backed by deep-research when needed, owns current evidence discovery, local-first escalation, fact/inference boundaries, freshness, and synthesis. Foundation Architecture already owns authority and independent research routing, so the internal generic research method is redundant.

Exact-pinned ECC search-first owns research-before-code, repository-first discovery, candidate evaluation, and adopt/extend/build generic HOW. Foundation Architecture supplies the authority/pinning seam and target repository truth remains first, so no internal reuse wrapper is required.

Exact-pinned ECC security-review owns generic security implementation/checklist HOW. Foundation retains only the irreducible threat-path, trust/authority-boundary, evidence-severity, and fail-closed review delta needed to preserve Foundation assurance semantics without adopting ECC examples as authority.

No exact-pinned external capability owns Foundation governance change admission, rationalization-taxonomy closure, and anti-overengineering consequences. Generic build-vs-reuse, architecture review, and language/source-layout HOW now route through target/ECC owners; the surviving skill is reduced to the Foundation-specific simplicity boundary.

Exact-pinned ECC verification-loop owns generic build/type/lint/test/diff completion HOW. Foundation retains acceptance-to-evidence mapping, evidence-layer separation, exact-candidate binding, authoritative-verifier boundaries, and deterministic execution-bundle semantics that ECC does not provide.
